gloss: to oust; to dethrone; to drive out of a position

definitions.gloss: to oust; to dethrone; to topple from power
definitions.explanation: To force someone out of a position of power or authority. Often used in political and competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: ライバルを{追|お}い{落|お}とす。
{選挙|せんきょ}で{現職|げんしょく}を{追|お}い{落|お}とした。
examples.english: The incumbent was ousted in the election.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいチームが{首位|しゅい}のチームを{追|お}い{落|お}として{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: The new team toppled the leading team and won the championship.

notes:
A compound verb from {追|お}う (to chase) + {落|お}とす (to drop, bring down). Implies forceful removal from a high position.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the person being ousted, から for the position

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ライバルを{追|お}い{落|お}とす: to dethrone a rival
- {政権|せいけん}から{追|お}い{落|お}とす: to oust from power
- {首位|しゅい}から{追|お}い{落|お}とす: to knock from the top position
- {地位|ちい}から{追|お}い{落|お}とす: to force out of a position

USAGE:
Used in politics, sports, and business competition. Carries a strong, aggressive nuance — the removal is deliberate and forceful.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追|お}い{出|だ}す: to drive out, to expel (more general)
- {引|ひ}きずり{下|お}ろす: to drag down from a position
